verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a plugin platform with manifests, schemas, and MCP-backed integrations, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for it. The evidence contains no versioned API and no documented deprecation policy. The nearest items are adjacent: a note that legacy `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` files remain a supported compatibility fallback, and an instruction to declare the Agent Plugins schema. Neither amounts to versioned APIs or a deprecation timeline, so neither earns credit.
